main_results.result: V3 retains provenance-aware next-ADMIT replay and restores ordinary prepare_commit API parity.
Ordinary COMMIT path, six-process duplicate ADMIT/RESERVE races, late SLOT/deadline CLOSE orderings, and deterministic-attempt replay were executed.

Current attempt ledger allows deterministic replay from a caller-supplied retry policy without requiring a pre-score determinism certificate; an outcome-adaptive replay counterexample raises a fair Bernoulli success probability from 0.5 to 0.75.

validated_contracts: V3 ordinary non-crash COMMIT path: one scorer call, bound SLOT digest equals COMMIT slot_event_digest, runtime-provenance audit score equals the generated score, clean replay.
Six simultaneous independent processes racing the same ADMIT produced exactly one durable winner and five StableLockCASMismatch losers.

Six simultaneous independent processes racing the same slot RESERVE produced exactly one durable winner, five CAS losers, and exactly one authorized scorer call. A fresh context reconciled the winner's durable SLOT to COMMIT and CLOSE without rescore.

When a deadline CLOSE frame and late SLOT frame are prepared from the same durable prefix, whichever append wins CAS determines the single scientific history: CLOSE-first fail-closes the missing slot; SLOT-first invalidates stale CLOSE and requires recovery COMMIT before compliant CLOSE.
Explicit deterministic-attempt replay can reissue a fresh-epoch permit for the same attempt_id and preserve score only when the scorer is actually deterministic in that attempt identity.

new_gap.name: deterministic_replay_not_bound_to_determinism_certificate
new_gap.reason: DETERMINISTIC_REPLAY is accepted as a retry_policy string and is not cryptographically or provenance-bound to a runtime/scorer determinism certificate. Same attempt_id alone cannot guarantee same score.
new_gap.existence_bias: With a stochastic fair Bernoulli scorer, if the caller persists successes but drops failures before SLOT and replays once, accepted success rises from 0.5 to 0.75; with up to k attempts the construction gives 1-2^-k.
new_gap.safe_default: FAIL_CLOSED remains safe because it never authorizes a new stochastic launch after recovery.

measurement_validity_rules: For multi-process races, scorer invocation count is a first-class scientific metric. One durable reservation is insufficient if losing processes can already execute stochastic scoring.
Whole-prefix CAS under the stable sidecar lock converts duplicate ADMIT/RESERVE contenders into one durable winner before any permit exists for losers in the tested flow.
Process-local MAC affinity is both a safety property and an architecture constraint: the process that receives a FAIL_CLOSED permit must perform first score launch itself.

DETERMINISTIC_REPLAY must be separately authorized by a pre-score, runtime-fingerprint-specific determinism contract. Without it, retry/replay can change the estimand or create choose-among-retries bias.
Deadline races may affect resolution but may not be post-hoc selected; durable prefix order plus CAS is the authority.
scope_limitations: Single-host cooperative POSIX only; no NFS/object-store/multi-host guarantee.
Six-process race is a concrete stress test, not an exhaustive scheduler-state proof.
Deterministic replay was positively tested with a hash-based deterministic scalar scorer; production LLM runtime determinism remains a separate empirical/certification problem.
The current V3 context is research code; no deployment/publication claim is made.
frontier: Design a forward-only deterministic-replay authorization contract that is fixed before scoring and binds runtime fingerprint, scorer/decoder configuration, protected equality level, attempt-id version, certification evidence and invalidation conditions. Keep FAIL_CLOSED unchanged for uncertified paths.
Integrate that authorization by versioning the reserved-score runtime binding rather than silently changing the historical attempt ledger; verify historical reservations are not reinterpreted.

Stress deterministic replay with actual repeated inference traces under a fixed runtime fingerprint, measuring raw/token/score/sign equivalence separately and refusing replay authorization if the protected statistic is not deterministic.

Expand duplicate ADMIT/RESERVE races across more process counts and random stagger schedules, and add forced process death immediately after reservation ACK, after score return and after bound SLOT fsync.
Only if cross-process scoring is needed, design an explicit handoff protocol; do not weaken process-epoch MAC invalidation merely to make permits transferable.
exact_next_action: Implement a role-local forward-only deterministic-replay authorization facade over the exact attempt ledger. Require a pre-score replay contract for DETERMINISTIC_REPLAY, bind its digest into the RESERVE event, require exact match on fresh-epoch permit reissue, and leave FAIL_CLOSED wire behavior unchanged. Then run positive deterministic and adversarial stochastic replay tests plus historical-reservation compatibility checks.
